name: commmerce-site-crawler
description: Plug-and-play product crawler for any store built on the commmerce.com website builder. Discovers all product URLs via sitemap + category crawl, scrapes title/price/images/description, converts images to WebP at 3 sizes, and exports CSV + MongoDB-ready JSON.

scripts.full: node run.js --mode discover && node run.js --mode crawl && node run.js --mode export
